FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

California fishing licence

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need a sport fishing licence in fresh or ocean water. Children and public-pier anglers can still need species report cards.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-12

Who needs one

  • Anglers aged 16 or older, unless exempt.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 16.
  • Fishing from a qualifying public pier in ocean or bay waters; species report cards can still apply.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
One-day sport fishingany1 specified day$21.09 USD
Two-day sport fishingany2 consecutive days$32.40 USD
Non-resident 10-daynon resident10 consecutive days$64.54 USD
Non-resident sport fishingnon resident365 days$174.14 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Ocean Enhancement Validation · $7.30 USD
    Ocean fishing south of Point Arguello; not required with one-day or two-day licences.
  • Species report cards
    Required for specified species and areas, including steelhead and sturgeon.
  • Second Rod Validation · $20.26 USD
    Eligible inland fishing with two rods; not waters restricted to artificial lures or barbless hooks.

Saltwater

The same licence covers ocean fishing. Southern ocean waters can require an extra validation.

Rules visitors should know

  • Report-card duties can apply even without a licence.
  • A second-rod validation applies to eligible inland two-rod fishing.

How to buy

Use CDFW online licence sales or a licence agent. Eligible licences can appear in the CDFW License App.

License-free days

CDFW lists July 3 and September 4, 2027 as free fishing days. Species report cards and other fishing rules still apply.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in California?

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need a sport fishing licence in fresh or ocean water. Children and public-pier anglers can still need species report cards.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in California?

One-day sport fishing: $21.09 USD; Two-day sport fishing: $32.40 USD; Non-resident 10-day: $64.54 USD; Non-resident sport fishing: $174.14 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in California?

Use CDFW online licence sales or a licence agent. Eligible licences can appear in the CDFW License App.
